entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, you seemed real fired up[n]back when we first met.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Was that an act Mona put you up to?[n]Y'know... the beauty thingy?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That was... um...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was trying to be a heroine of justice.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh... Is that a joke?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You moron!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Ever since I was young, people around me[n]have never seen me for who I really am.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: They would be kind to me just to please[n]my father, and would get money and[n]presents in exchange.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Adults, teachers, even friends... It seemed[n]like everyone smiled at me for their own[n]personal gain.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's why you kept the details of your[n]family a secret at school...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But the female superheroes I used to see[n]on TV were so great!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: They always fought for others, not[n]themselves... and they were always[n]happy.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wanted to be just like that! Even though[n]I knew it was a fantasy... I still looked up[n]to them.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Everyone goes wild over heroes at some[n]point.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's fine havin' someone like that on our[n]side, right, Joker?
Of course.
Don't make me say it.
You're too excited.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, you're not the kinda guy who gets[n]embarrassed. We're gonna be heroes too!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, not cool! Don't you think that's[n]a little harsh considerin' what we were[n]just talkin' about!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle*

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: What are you doing here!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Huh? Huh!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is insane on so many levels!

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: I thought I told you not to associate with[n]vulgar people!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That bastard!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Him!? Did he come into the Palace too!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No! He might look the same, but that isn't[n]the real person.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Remember what I explained to you[n]earlier?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You mean about the cognition thing?

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: What are you mumbling about?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Do you recall what I said before?[n]That I would do my best for you?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This is my answer to that!

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: Are those... the rumored Phantom[n]Thieves?

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: ...I see!

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: You're handing them over to me as a plea[n]for forgiveness!

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: "Overcome failure at any cost, even if[n]it means betraying others"... You truly[n]embody the Okumura motto!

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: Very well. Join me!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Why do you only ever think about[n]gains and losses!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's why the company has a bad[n]reputation... All because you treat[n]people like they're tools!

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: To gain, you must give... One must be[n]resolved to give even more if they wish[n]to stand above others.

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: We are on vastly different levels...[n]and soon, I will rise to a new stage—[n]the political world!

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: The cold reality of kicking people down[n]is a part of business! Virtue and sentiment[n]are for losers.

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: *chuckle* Okumura Foods shall be the[n]foundation of my victory!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: His company is just a stepping stone...

entries.speaker: Haru's Fiancé
entries.en: Mr. Okumura, we don't need a girl who's[n]been soiled by thieves.

entries.speaker: Haru's Fiancé
entries.en: Unless you make some compromises,[n]I can't introduce her to my father.

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: She needn't be your lawful wife anymore...[n]Take her as your lover, or whatever it is[n]you desire.

entries.speaker: Haru's Fiancé
entries.en: Very well... I accept.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Lover?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was raised under this company's[n]wealth... I even accepted a political[n]marriage for you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This is not what we discussed!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Father! You want me to be that man's[n]plaything just to satisfy your own[n]ambitions?

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: Hmph, why fret? You should be overjoyed[n]that you're fulfilling your role as an[n]Okumura daughter.

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: This is the only value you've had from[n]the very beginning.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So... even his own daughter's life is[n]a commodity to him.
